prompt:
Create ONE single connected cave environment image for visual review, using the ATTACHED Secret of Mana Gaia's Navel INTERIOR map as the strong primary visual reference. Be very faithful to its actual SNES material treatment and architecture. This is ONE cave, ONE image, ONE season, NO multiple panels, NO tileset sheet. Do not imitate any previous AlgoLand grotto or generic golden cave.

Read the reference carefully: the unreachable area above and behind the visible cave walls is SOLID BLACK. The cliffs are narrow pale tan needle-like eroded mineral ridges with deep red-brown and dark purple shadows. They are NOT rounded chunky golden boulders or flat-topped cylindrical columns. The walkable earth is dark desaturated warm brown with restrained olive and reddish pixel clusters; it is NOT bright yellow sand. The native pixel art is simple readable 16-bit SNES RPG artwork, viewed straight top-down with vertical cliff faces visible toward the bottom. Water is subdued deep green-teal. Small stone steps are carved into ledges and visibly connect the lower walking surface to the raised one. Black rock voids define winding irregular walkable paths.

Compose a compact but convincing ORIGINAL connected cave layout, not a copy of the reference's precise map: bottom-center entrance passage opens into an irregular lower chamber, a broad winding path heads left then bends up, short steps ascend to an upper-middle shelf; the path continues around the right of one small deep green underground pool and exits into a dark cave opening in the upper right. One sheltered alcove left of the middle path has a modest patch of dull moss against the wall. A second narrow stair flight makes the two elevation levels easy to understand. All walkable regions remain naturally connected. Wall outlines meander with inward and outward corners; every cliff segment meets its neighbors continuously, including the stairs and water's bank. Give the pool a continuous rocky ledge of the same stone as the cave walls, with correctly joined corners. Only two or three small integrated pointed stalagmites against walls; large quiet readable walking areas between them. No scattered decorations, crates, lamps or giant glowing crystals. No characters, no enemies, no HUD, no text or labels, no torches, no waterfalls, no lava.

Maintain the visual quality of the actual SNES reference. This is a finished cave scene illustration for visual review, NOT a production TileMap or proof of engine integration.
